en.title: Content strategy
en.description: Plan useful content topics around your audience, goals, and distribution channels.
tasks: Plan useful content topics around your audience, goals, and distribution channels.
prerequisites: An AI agent that can read local Skill files. Provide your task context and source materials.
en.example: Use content-strategy for this task: Plan useful content topics around your audience, goals, and distribution channels. First ask me for the missing context. Use only the evidence I provide or sources you can verify, and explain what I should check in the result.
en.expectedResult: A task-specific draft or analysis, with assumptions, evidence gaps, and clear next steps for you to review.
limitations: Review factual claims and proposed actions before relying on the output.
Source and package checks are complete; no end-to-end Agent task verification is claimed.
Related skills mentioned upstream are optional separate workflows; they are not automatically installed. Marketing examples and numerical claims need independent verification.

zh.title: 内容策略
zh.description: 围绕受众、目标和分发渠道规划内容主题。
tasks: 围绕受众、目标和分发渠道规划内容主题。
prerequisites: 可读取本地 Skill 文件的 AI Agent；准备任务背景与原始材料。
zh.example: 请使用 content-strategy 完成以下任务：围绕受众、目标和分发渠道规划内容主题。 先询问缺少的背景信息，只使用我提供的证据或可以核验的来源，并说明结果需要检查哪些内容。
zh.expectedResult: 得到针对任务的草稿或分析，包含假设、证据缺口和可供检查的后续步骤。
limitations: 使用输出前核对事实依据和建议操作。
已完成来源与包文件检查，尚未声明完成 Agent 端到端任务验证。
上游提到的相关 Skills 属于独立流程，不会自动安装。营销案例和数值结论需自行核验。
